# ona_team (Resource)

Ona team in the organization associated with the authenticated provider token. Team membership is managed separately.

For product context, see [Manage teams](https://ona.com/docs/ona/organizations/teams).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name shown in Ona. Must be between 3 and 80 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time when the team was created.
- `id` (String) Team ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh

terraform import ona_team.platform 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
